relevance.why: This is exactly the Claude Code tooling layer a solo founder should standardise: memory, official plugins, codebase map, automated review before ship, token savings. The security-style review finding shown is the kind of thing a solo dev misses.

implement_score.why: All five are free installs; ~1 hour to set up and a week to judge. Highest value: Anthropic official plugins + Code Review (official, maintained) and claude-mem. Ponytail is a quick A/B on token cost. Skip the $9/month club.
